facts: Saudi Ministry of Commerce reported more than 71,000 commercial registrations issued in Q2 2026.

The same Q2 release reported more than 1.91 million active commercial registrations and highlighted tourism attractiveness plus promising Vision 2030 activities including e-commerce and cloud computing.
GASTAT reported that the e-commerce sales index increased 9.8% year over year in Q2 2026; retail increased 13.4%, wholesale 6.5% and motor-vehicle activity 2.4% in the same release.
A Ministry of Commerce Q1 2026 release reported more than 19,000 commercial registrations in artificial-intelligence activities, up 240% over five years.
signals.what_it_proves: Broad Saudi business formation remains active, official sources highlight e-commerce/cloud/AI growth themes, and aggregate commerce indicators show continued digital and retail activity that justifies evidence-backed operational research.
signals.what_it_does_not_prove: Named buyer pain, relationship, consent, budget, decision access, urgency, purchase intent, sector-wide automation ROI or that aggregate growth translates into a specific Dealix opportunity.
dealix_use: account-list research from lawful/public sources only
retail and e-commerce operations diagnostic hypothesis design
AI-enabled customer-support, order, returns and back-office workflow research
cloud and software operations readiness research

facts: CST guidance covers AI for internal operations, customer-facing use and AI agents.
The guide frames readiness across business context, data, infrastructure, skills and culture.
CST's Saudi Internet Report 2025 dashboard reports AI-tool adoption among Saudi internet users at 45.2% and states adoption was more than double the previous year.
The same dashboard reports work-related AI use at 17.3% and programming/technical use at 13.5%.
signals.what_it_proves: AI adoption/readiness is an active Saudi operational topic and AI-tool usage is already broad enough to justify evidence-backed workflow/readiness research.
signals.what_it_does_not_prove: That any named company needs Dealix, has budget or purchase intent, has authorized outreach, or will realize a claimed ROI.

facts: CST provides a technology-enterprise registration and reference-directory service for organizations in IT and emerging technologies.
The service page states registration is currently optional and has no registration fee.
signals.what_it_proves: A regulator-maintained technology-company classification/reference surface exists.
signals.what_it_does_not_prove: Consent to contact, partnership, qualification, customer need or endorsement by CST.

facts: GASTAT publishes a monthly Construction Cost Index and lists 2026 releases through June/July on the current statistics page.

signals.what_it_does_not_prove: Project award volume, named-customer pain, deal probability or automation ROI.

facts: ZATCA announced Wave 25 on 24 July 2026 for notified taxpayers whose VAT-taxable revenues exceeded SAR 187,500 in 2022, 2023, 2024 or 2025.
The published integration deadline for notified Wave 25 taxpayers is 2027-02-01.
ZATCA states Phase Two requires integration of the taxpayer's e-invoicing solution with the Fatoora platform, a specified e-invoice format and additional invoice fields.
signals.what_it_proves: A time-bound technical integration requirement exists for notified taxpayers in the stated wave, with concrete solution-integration and invoice-data requirements.
signals.what_it_does_not_prove: That Dealix is a tax adviser, certifier, approved solution provider, or that a named taxpayer needs Dealix; this signal does not by itself establish penalties, non-compliance or legal advice.

facts: NCA publishes minimum cybersecurity controls relevant to the defined private-sector population outside critical national infrastructure.
NCA announced a public consultation on AI Cybersecurity Guidelines on 2026-07-05.
NCA described four AI cybersecurity domains: governance, defense, resilience and third-party cybersecurity.
NCA stated the consultation scope includes generative AI and agentic AI, with feedback deadline 2026-08-05; the current public-consultations page lists that consultation as closed.

NCA announced on 2026-09-08 that it conducted inspection visits on cybersecurity-related activities at national entities, including entities and critical infrastructure from the public and private sectors, to verify implementation of regulatory requirements and strengthen compliance with cybersecurity requirements and best practices.
NCA also stated that monitoring and inspection activity continues under its regulatory mandate.
signals.what_it_proves: Formal private-sector cybersecurity controls exist for relevant organizations; AI and agentic-AI cybersecurity governance has been an active official Saudi policy topic; and NCA is actively exercising monitoring/inspection functions, which strengthens the value of evidence-readiness and governed control workflows for in-scope organizations.
signals.what_it_does_not_prove: Certification status, applicability to every company, non-compliance by any named organization, audit authority for Dealix, legal conclusions, customer demand, buyer intent, or that a closed consultation text is a final binding control.
dealix_use: readiness artifact generation with human/compliance review
